Findings.Comment: `Touch` now treats its TTL argument as milliseconds and passes it straight to `PExpire`, but the only call site, `internal/session/manager.go:58`, still passes `int64(m.idle.Seconds())`. With an idle timeout of e.g. 30 minutes, the store now sets a TTL of 1800 milliseconds instead of 1800 seconds, so sessions are dropped roughly 1000x earlier than the manager's `idle` policy intends. Either the caller must pass `m.idle.Milliseconds()` or `Touch` must keep seconds semantics; as landed, every touched session expires almost immediately.
